{
  "phoneNote": "The arched salon photos and warm palette feel considered, but the first screen omits the location and wastes space between the introduction, price link and photos.",
  "desktopNote": "The prominent salon photos work well, but oversized typography dominates the hero while the location remains buried near the bottom.",

    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Add a concise location line to both heroes; reduce the desktop headline size and distinguish phone booking as the primary action from the secondary price link.",
    "Tighten the phone hero’s vertical gaps and reduce desktop section padding, especially around the sparse price grid and team section.",
    "Consolidate address, opening hours and contact details into one visit-and-booking section, leaving a compact legal footer."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop footers repeat the address-and-directions block and opening-hours table already presented above."
  ]
}
